notes.title: Big update from Luden.io
notes.content:
Hello all :) Oleg from Luden.io is here. I can't wait to tell you that today our new game Learning Factory finally becomes available. We'll be super happy if you stop by and join us on this adventure of making the best educational game we can.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150090/Learning_Factory/

Please don't hesitate to drop me a line in Discord or privately via oleg.chumakov@luden.io. I am always happy to talk :)
